_comment: Block manifest for `klt signoff --manifest` (issue #331) -- the machine-
graded statement of this block's gap to T1 in
`2AMLogic/klayout-tools`' docs/design-evidence-tiers.md, and the file the
fleet roll-up (2AMLogic/2am#956) reads to place this block's row.
EVERY CITATION IS KEYED PER PARTITION, including the checklist's
kind-independent items (3, 4, 6). A bare `"3"` key would render the same
citation in BOTH partitions' rows, which would have this block's ANALOG
GDS standing as the digital partition's DRC evidence. Keying each side
separately keeps every row's evidence about the silicon that row names --
the whole point of a mixed-signal claim stating its partition boundary --
at the cost of leaving a row honestly uncited where that side has no
artifact of its own (4.digital, 6.digital, 7.digital).
THE ONE EXCEPTION TO 'THIS DIRECTORY STORES NO EVIDENCE OF ITS OWN' is
item 8's pair of citations, which point at signoff/evidence/ rather than
at layout/, sim/ or design/. T1 item 8 names no `klt` verb, so no verb's
output can satisfy it structurally; `klt signoff` grades it through an
opt-in generic evidence envelope a project writes itself
(klayout-tools#1152, and since #2044 item 8 accepts `generic` and
nothing else). Both envelopes wrap -- and both pin the sha256 of --
sim/characterization-summary.md, which is where the evidence actually
lives; they are two files because this manifest keys per partition and
the two halves assert different things about different silicon. See
signoff/evidence/README.md, and note especially what an item-8 `met`
does NOT mean: it is a claim about the REPORT, not about the design,
which still fails three ratified rows. That question is item 5's.
ITEM 11 IS THE ONE COMPOUND ITEM (issue #2025): its manifest value is a
JSON array of ordinary file-backed entries rather than a single one --
here, the `klt erc` supply run plus the LVS report `4.analog` already
cites -- and `klt signoff` requires every part before it will grade the
row at all (`_grade_power_delivery`). See gf180-sar-adc#347 and the
evidence record under signoff/records/ for why this reads `unmet` /
`supply_spec_incomplete` rather than `met`.
THIS FILE IS THE CITATION LIST AND NOTHING ELSE. Every justification --
why each citation was chosen, why each uncited item is uncited, what the
DRC coverage gaps behind item 3's `clean` are, and where the partition
boundary runs -- lives in signoff/README.md and in the evidence record
under signoff/records/. Keep it that way: `klt signoff` tolerates this
`_comment` key today, but the manifest is consumed by an out-of-repo
grader and must stay strippable down to block/kind/evidence.
Paths are REPO-ROOT-RELATIVE and resolve against the invoking process's
working directory (there is no manifest-relative anchoring), so run the
grader from the repo root:
klt signoff --manifest signoff/gf180-sar-adc.manifest.json --format json
or, equivalently and with the pin checked first:
python3 signoff/run_signoff.py --regen
Do not hand-edit a citation without re-running `--regen`: the committed
report under signoff/reports/ and the repo-side freshness pins in
signoff/freshness.json are both asserted against this file by
`python3 signoff/run_signoff.py --check`, which runs in CI.
